description: Send the photos and GPSR contacts of up to 25 products to their EXISTING Amazon offers — a real write to the seller's live listings: Amazon's photos are replaced with the CRM's, the manufacturer and EU responsible person with the companies set on the product's brand or supplier, and — when asked for — the title and bullet points written for Amazon and the safety documents. Nothing else on the offer changes (a partial patch). Run preview_amazon_listing_content first and pass only products whose status is ready. Refused until the owner switches on AI publishing, and while photo/GPSR updates are not armed on the Amazon connection. Returns the same rows as the preview, with status sent where Amazon accepted the patch; notAttempted lists products not reached in the time budget — call again with those ids. Never tell the user a change is live unless its row says sent; Amazon shows it to buyers within minutes. Idempotent: the same content again leaves the offer as it was. The result echoes the workspace.

parts.description: What to send: images (the product's main photo and up to 8 more, replacing Amazon's), gpsr (the manufacturer and the EU responsible person, as the emails of records the seller created in Seller Central — taken from the product's brand, else its supplier), texts (the title and bullet points written for Amazon with set_amazon_listing_texts — nothing is sent when none were written) and documents (the product's safety PDFs, set with set_product_safety_documents). Default: all four; a part with nothing to send is reported in skipped.

productIds.description: The products whose Amazon offers to update, at most 25 ids from search_products or inspect_amazon_listings.

items.description: A product id returned by search_products.

name: update_amazon_listing_content
